summary.text: Profound Immortal Sound is one of four variations of Wu Yong's immortal battlefield killer move Four Clear Transforming Winds. Fang Yuan judges it the strongest offensive variation.

claims.text: After clear jade dripping wind, Wu Yong laughs, reveals himself, and names another variation profound immortal sound, inviting Feng Jiu Ge to evaluate it as a sound path cultivator. Mild clear wind murmurs fill the battlefield and resound in Fang Yuan’s mind until his reverse flow robe shakes and billows. Fang Yuan judges this variation the strongest of the four in offensive power, and notes that reverse flow protection seal can protect only himself, not Feng Jiu Ge. Four Clear Transforming Winds has four variations: clear wind blades, clear jade lightning, clear jade dripping wind, and profound immortal sound.

Whether clear wind blades, clear jade lightning, clear jade dripping wind, or profound immortal sound, the essence of those variation moves is wind path; the Wu clan ancestor who created the battlefield could imitate other paths with wind, touching sword, lightning, water, and sound path. Profound immortal sound grows more concentrated and sonorous until musical sounds on Feng Jiu Ge are almost inaudible, Fang Yuan’s reverse flow robe shakes harder, and Reverse Flow River shrinks startlingly fast. Blood flows from Feng Jiu Ge’s nose, mouth, and eyes while his body shakes more intensely under that pressure.
